scope.workerHeap: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage on the Search Worker target (usedSize = V8 isolate used heap incl. uncollected garbage); requested every 500 ms while no request is in flight; sampled max, not a continuous peak
scope.lifecycle: CDP Target domain (discover + page-session auto-attach, flatten), Inspector.detached / Inspector.targetCrashed on the page session, Target.targetCrashed, browser WebSocket close
scope.pageEvents: the page's own `[pg2c25d2b]` console.info relay lines (Runtime.consoleAPICalled), kept as received; they duplicate what the page saw so it survives a page loss
scope.crashDump: after a page crash: new Crashpad report files of this isolated profile; only the process type, the loaded origin and the V8 OOM crash key strings are extracted, the dump itself is not committed
